title: Operations durable history variants
description: Merged into the operations query schema only. No client-selected storage path, repair flag, restored grants, or game effect is accepted.

oneOf.description: List this session's durable committed observation records. Continuations bind the journal head and current session anchor. History is observed endpoints, not complete game history.

Verify and replay an exact committed record, then run a stateless query without bridge I/O. Authorization is checked at the present session anchor. The result names the historical anchor and explicitly does not claim current freshness.
